about_the_game:
TRANSMISSION INCOMING...

AGENT RECRUITMENT PROTOCOL ACTIVATED

Welcome to Necrova Industries, Agent.

You've been selected for our most classified operations. The Founder, Lunix, has a message for you:
"Congratulations on your recruitment, Agent [USERNAME]. I'm Lunix, The founder of Necrova. We've developed something extraordinary - a fully functional dimensional teleporter that can breach the barriers between realities. Your mission? Navigate these unstable dimensions and complete critical objectives our research team has prepared."

"Oh, and try not to die. Insurance claims are a nightmare."


_____________________________________________
YOUR DATATOOL ARSENAL

Every agent receives a state-of-the-art DataTool with three essential operational modes:

🔗 HOOK MODE
Deploy advanced grappling technology to traverse dimensional terrain and pull your fellow agents out of rifts.

🧲 MAGNET MODE
Harness electromagnetic fields to attract, repel, and control metallic objects in your environment.

💻 HACK MODE
Interface directly with dimensional technology and override security systems blocking your objectives.

Additional upgrades may become available as operations expand... if you survive long enough to see them.
_____________________________________________
MISSION BRIEFING - AGENT JAMES, FIELD COORDINATOR

"Agent, I'll be straight with you - we're still cataloging the full scope of what you'll encounter out there. What we do know is your primary assignment:"

🛰️ OPERATION: DATA FUSION

OBJECTIVE: Restore our dimensional satellite network across three confirmed stable pocket dimensions.

SITUATION: Hostile anomalies have systematically displaced our pre-positioned satellite arrays. These devices are critical for maintaining dimensional stability and communications between realities.

MISSION PARAMETERS:

  • Navigate one of three mapped dimensional zones

  • Locate displaced satellite equipment

  • Restore satellites to their designated coordinates

  • Extract safely before dimensional collapse

SURVIVAL RATING: Casualties not included in standard compensation package

Are you ready to step through the portal, Agent?

The dimensions are waiting.


Necrova is not responsible for temporal displacement, reality fragmentation, or existential dread.

_____________________________________________

Welcome To 4FingerStudios!

This is our first attempt at making a Story/Game for the global to see, Necrova Is a Special Story that has been years in the making. I really do hope you enjoy our game and the story behind it. Thank you for checking us out! community is key and everything we work around your words, worlds, and ideas are what fuel everything we do, We cant wait to see ya in game.
-Dev

content_descriptors.notes:
In Escape Protocol you will experience Cartoon Violence in our PVP game there will be some maps that have blood or gore as decorative pieces.
there is crude language and certain crude emotes like Flipping the bird
EP will have Jump scares and a lot of creepy horror elements
